input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: cyclehound resolves tsconfig/jsconfig paths aliases

errors.what: Passed the cyclehound binary as tests/bench/measure.py's first argument, which is the output file; it truncated the binary (and its hard link in target/release/deps) to 0 bytes and cargo then thought it fresh
errors.fix: deleted both zero-byte files and rebuilt

errors.what: strip_query cut '#lib/x' at the leading '#', so a #-prefixed alias resolved to nothing
errors.fix: a leading '#' is kept as part of the name; caught by tests/aliases.rs

doc_friction.issue: takes an output path as its first positional argument with no usage line or guard; passing the command first silently overwrites the binary being measured (fixed in this PR: a usage line and a refusal to overwrite an executable)

notes: Explore idea: the README-named next slice of cyclehound (Rust import-graph tool, dev-tools-in-Rust direction): tsconfig/jsconfig paths+baseUrl+extends by TypeScript's rules. Reference was TypeScript 5.9.3's resolveModuleName (tests/bench/ts_alias_edges.cjs): 1436 alias edges each side, 1436 common, over 16 configs and 2502 bare imports in ventures/. ventures/ edges 11560 -> 12996, no new cycles, unused-export findings 5648 -> 5540, time unchanged (0.25-0.28 s). Local checks: cargo test --release 26 pass, clippy -D warnings clean, node --test (cyclehound) 16 pass, run_venture_tests.py cyclehound ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes results in the PR.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
